code_patterns_discovered.name: DND_KIT_KANBAN_INTEGRATION
code_patterns_discovered.description: Drag-and-drop kanban board using dnd-kit with DndContext, DragOverlay, and SortableContext for accessible drag-and-drop with keyboard support

code_patterns_discovered.name: STATE_MACHINE_VALIDATION_PATTERN
code_patterns_discovered.description: Client-side state machine validation before allowing drag-and-drop transitions. Uses VALID_TRANSITIONS map to enforce legal status changes.

code_patterns_discovered.name: DRAGGABLE_CARD_WITH_USESORTABLE
code_patterns_discovered.description: Individual draggable card component using useSortable hook with transform styles and isDragging opacity feedback

code_patterns_discovered.name: DROPPABLE_COLUMN_WITH_USEDROPABLE
code_patterns_discovered.description: Droppable column container using useDroppable hook with isOver visual feedback and SortableContext for internal sorting

code_patterns_discovered.name: TANSTACK_QUERY_WITH_MUTATION_CALLBACK
code_patterns_discovered.description: TanStack Query mutation with onSuccess cache invalidation and onError toast notifications

discoveries.discovery: dnd-kit requires BOTH PointerSensor and KeyboardSensor for full accessibility
discoveries.lesson: Always configure both PointerSensor (mouse/touch) and KeyboardSensor (arrow keys, space/enter) in useSensors(). Accessibility essential for all users.

discoveries.discovery: Client-side state machine validation MUST match backend exactly
discoveries.lesson: Before building status-based UI, read backend router to extract VALID_TRANSITIONS. Keep UI and backend in sync. No more 'backend rejected valid move' errors.

discoveries.discovery: 'failed' status is valid transition target but should not appear as column in UI
discoveries.lesson: Not all valid state transitions need visible columns. 'failed' is terminal state for error handling. Features that fail moved off board.

discoveries.discovery: DragOverlay needs activeId state to show preview of dragged card
discoveries.lesson: DragOverlay requires separate activeId state managed via onDragStart/onDragEnd. Shows visual preview of card being dragged.

discoveries.discovery: SortableContext must receive array of item IDs, not item objects
discoveries.lesson: items={features.map(f => f.id)} not items={features}. dnd-kit uses IDs for collision detection.

discoveries.discovery: All 3 iterations involved state machine validation issues caught in QA
discoveries.lesson: State machine bugs are common. Validate VALID_TRANSITIONS before starting. Add tests checking each transition rule.

discoveries.discovery: 46 new tests written for kanban components covering drag logic and edge cases
discoveries.lesson: Complex component = comprehensive testing. Tests verify: drag start/end, invalid transitions, column filtering, empty states.

discoveries.discovery: 3 iterations is within normal range for M-sized dnd-kit component
discoveries.lesson: dnd-kit adds complexity: multiple hooks, state machine, drag animations. 3 iterations expected for quality implementation.
